physics-killer-04.title: An jefa ƙwallo a
physics-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-04.material: An jefa ƙwallo a kwance daga gefen dutse mai tsayin $20\,\mathrm{m}$, kuma ta faɗi a ƙasa a nisan a kwance $30\,\mathrm{m}$ daga dutsen. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kuma aka yi watsi da juriyar iska, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, gudun ƙwallon a lokacin da ta taɓa ƙasa, da $\tan\theta$ na kusurwar $\theta$ da hanyar gudun ke yi da fili a kwance a wannan lokacin?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: An jefa ƙwallo a kwance daga gefen dutse mai tsayin $20\,\mathrm{m}$, kuma ta faɗi a ƙasa a nisan a kwance $30\,\mathrm{m}$ daga dutsen. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kuma aka yi watsi da juriyar iska, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, gudun ƙwallon a lokacin da ta taɓa ƙasa, da $\tan\theta$ na kusurwar $\theta$ da hanyar gudun ke yi da fili a kwance a wannan lokacin?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: A tsaye $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. A kwance $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kafin saukowa $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Idan aka ƙara gudun a matsayin $v_0+gt=35$ sai amsa mara kyau ①; idan aka juya $\tan\theta$ sai $\frac34$ (amsa mara kyau ②); idan aka ɗauki ɓangaren tsaye $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kaɗai a matsayin gudu sai amsa mara kyau ④.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
